delete.description:
Delete a runner and every Agent pinned to it.

Refuses while the runner holds a live control socket (the runner's only
presence authority; mirrors delete_inert_user_runners) and while any
pinned Agent delete is inadmissible. Each Agent delete commits through the
sanctioned runner-agent delete path; the runner row and its assignment
rows are removed only once every pinned Agent is durably deleted.

history. Never advances the caller's read receipt (unlike the history
page): a jump is not a read-to-here.

post.description:
User retry / resume-confirm (FIXES.md D2): tick one durable user row
back to ``queued`` with a ``delivery_resubmitted`` evidence frame, then
re-arm the live leg when one exists. Owner-scoped (backend-service
identities pass, mirroring the read surface). Deliberately NOT built on
the messages-GET helpers — no read-receipt side effect (S8).

get.description: Observe the selected session/agent leg without any native operation.

Session metadata plus platform history state (last_message_id,
message_count, head_seq, receipts): 404 unknown, 403 not a participant,
422 invalid UUID.

No runtime access or participant binding. Serving the detail advances the
reader's user read receipt to the session head, best-effort (read-cursor
tracking is backend-owned, §15).

get.description:
Current derived summary plus queue position for this session.

``pending`` is worker-queue state only: true while this session is queued
or building. When the memory worker is disabled (``SESSION_MEMORY_ENABLED``
unset) ``pending`` stays false and ``POST summary/rebuild`` answers 503.
Search over already-indexed history is independent of worker availability.

AgentIntegrationMeta.title: AgentIntegrationMeta
AgentIntegrationMeta.description:
Per-provider integration toggle, keyed by provider name.

Effective semantics (documented here; enforcement lives in the
integrations facade and is NOT part of this write/read surface):
    effective_enabled = connected AND facade hyper_enabled AND
                        (meta.integrations[provider].enabled ?? true)
An absent provider entry means enabled; enabled=None clears the entry
back to that default.
